exposure: opportunity to view pre-abortion ultrasound scan
outcome: impact of viewing scan on decision to proceed with abortion
HCPs' practice of offering ultrasound viewing
cohort: Clients attending the Sandyford Termination of Pregnancy and Referral (TOPAR) unit for abortion assessment and healthcare professionals working in the TOPAR unit.
finding: The study found inconsistent practice within the unit regarding offering clients the opportunity to view their pre-abortion ultrasound scan, with almost half of clients offered the opportunity, and a majority of those accepting reported it either made them more likely to proceed or made no difference to their decision.
cross-section timing: Over a 4-month period during abortion assessment
